prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1187; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate pain and swelling in the right knee, with difficulty bearing weight in the first days after the incident. Initial examination showed moderate effusion, tenderness along the medial joint line, and restricted range of motion with pain on flexion beyond 90 degrees. Ligamentous stress testing was limited by guarding. Imaging was reviewed and showed no acute fracture, with soft tissue findings consistent with a medial collateral sprain.

Care consisted of 21 outpatient physical therapy and clinic visits over the course of treatment. Interventions included manual therapy, progressive range-of-motion and quadriceps strengthening exercises, gait training, and modalities for pain and swelling control. The patient's effusion resolved by the middle of the treatment course, and weight-bearing tolerance and flexion improved steadily. At the most recent visit, the patient reported mild intermittent discomfort with prolonged standing, full weight-bearing without assistive device, and flexion near normal limits. Residual strength deficit remains, and continued home exercise is recommended. Return to full activity is anticipated with ongoing self-directed conditioning.
